mapper.select: SELECT b.no, b.writer_no, b.guest_author_no, b.category, b.answer_status, b.title, b.content, b.view_count, b.created_date, b.modified_date, m.name AS writer_name, m.nickname AS writer_nickname, g.guest_name, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment bc WHERE bc.board_no = b.no ) AS answer_count FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_no = m.no LEFT JOIN guest_author g ON b.guest_author_no = g.no ORDER BY b.no DESC

SELECT b.no, b.writer_no, b.guest_author_no, b.category, b.answer_status, b.title, b.content, b.view_count, b.created_date, b.modified_date, m.name AS writer_name, m.nickname AS writer_nickname, g.guest_name, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment bc WHERE bc.board_no = b.no ) AS answer_count FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_no = m.no LEFT JOIN guest_author g ON b.guest_author_no = g.no WHERE b.no = #{no}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board ( writer_no, guest_author_no, category, title, content, answer_status ) VALUES ( #{writerNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{guestAuthorNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{category, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{answerStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT b.no, b.writer_no, b.guest_author_no, b.category, b.answer_status, b.title, b.content, b.view_count, b.created_date, b.modified_date, m.name AS writer_name, m.nickname AS writer_nickname, g.guest_name, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment bc WHERE bc.board_no = b.no ) AS answer_count FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_no = m.no LEFT JOIN guest_author g ON b.guest_author_no = g.no WHERE b.category = #{category} ORDER BY b.no DESC

SELECT b.no, b.writer_no, b.guest_author_no, b.category, b.answer_status, b.title, b.content, b.view_count, b.created_date, b.modified_date, m.name AS writer_name, m.nickname AS writer_nickname, g.guest_name, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment bc WHERE bc.board_no = b.no ) AS answer_count FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_no = m.no LEFT JOIN guest_author g ON b.guest_author_no = g.no WHERE ( b.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.nickname LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR g.guest_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ) ORDER BY b.no DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rn, board_data.* FROM ( SELECT b.no, b.writer_no, b.guest_author_no, b.category, b.answer_status, b.title, b.content, b.view_count, b.created_date, b.modified_date,
-- 회원 작성자 정보 m.name AS writer_name, m.nickname AS writer_nickname,
-- 비회원 작성자 이름 g.guest_name,
-- 게시글 답변 개수 ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment bc WHERE bc.board_no = b.no ) AS answer_count
FROM board b
-- 회원 작성자 연결 LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_no = m.no
-- 비회원 작성자 연결 LEFT JOIN guest_author g ON b.guest_author_no = g.no
WHERE b.category = #{category}
ORDER BY b.no DESC ) board_data
WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} )
WHERE rn >= #{startRow}

-- 회원 작성자 정보 m.name AS writer_name, m.nickname AS writer_nickname,

mapper.update: UPDATE board SET category = #{category}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, modified_date = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE no = #{no}
